mapper.select: SELECT id, name, gender, hobby, introduction, registered_date AS registeredDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM profile ORDER BY id
SELECT edited_date AS editedDate FROM profile_histories WHERE PROFILE_ID = #{id}
SELECT id, name, gender, hobby, introduction, registered_date AS registeredDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM profile WHERE name LIKE #{name} ORDER BY id
SELECT ID, NAME, GENDER, HOBBY, INTRODUCTION, REGISTERED_DATE AS REGISTEREDDATE, UPDATED_DATE AS UPDATEDDATE FROM PROFILE WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile ( name, gender, hobby, introduction, registered_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{gender}, #{hobby}, #{introduction}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE profile SET name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, hobby = #{hobby}, introduction = #{introduction}, updated_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
